description: This file defines the IQueueAdapterFactory interface, which provides methods for creating and retrieving various queue-related components such as adapters, caches, mappers, and failure handlers within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing queue adapters, caches, mappers, and failure handlers in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates a new queue adapter asynchronously.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires a delivery failure handler for a specified queue.
